title: Lead your #8 into the channel
brief: You get the ball deep, near the touchline. The pass to your #8's feet is blocked.
briefKid: The ball is coming to you. Where can your midfielder run?
question: Where does your pass go?

takeaway.standard: When the pass to a teammate's feet is blocked, play it into the space ahead of them if they will get there first.
takeaway.kid: Pass into the space in front of your midfielder, where they can run.

notes: A full-back's ball into space (PA8), which the pass generator never makes for full-backs (PASS_YIELD). Their midfielder stands in the lane to our #8's feet (PA4), but the space ahead of the #8 is free and the #8 gets there first. The keeper is the safe-but-slow decoy (PA2), and every pass inside goes across our own goal (PA10).
